generalAbilities.name: Shield Arm
generalAbilities.description: The iron warden has a shield built into its arm, that it can use as a steel shield (+2 to AC and Hardness 5). Because it's a part of the iron warden, all damage in excess of its Hardness is dealt only to the iron warden.

defensiveAbilities.name: Shield Block
defensiveAbilities.description:
See rules...

Trigger The monster has its shield raised and takes damage from a physical attack.

Effect The monster snaps its shield into place to deflect a blow. The shield prevents the monster from taking an amount of damage up to the shield's Hardness. The monster and the shield each take any remaining damage, possibly breaking or destroying the shield.

offensiveAbilities.name: Breath Poison
offensiveAbilities.description:
The iron warden exhales poisonous gas in a 10ft Burst centered on the corner of one of the iron warden's squares. The gas persists until the start of the warden's next turn. Any creature in the area (or that later enters the area) is exposed to the iron warden's poison.

The warden can't Breathe Poison again for 1d4 rounds.

offensiveAbilities.name: Inexorable March
offensiveAbilities.description: The iron warden Strides up to its Speed, pushing back each creature whose space it moves into and damaging them if they try to stop its movement. A creature can attempt to bar the way by succeeding at a DC 37 Fortitude Saving Throw save. On a critical success, the resisting creature takes no damage; otherwise, it's damaged as if hit by the iron warden's fist.

offensiveAbilities.name: Iron Warden Poison
offensiveAbilities.description:
Any drained value from this poison is reduced by 1 every hour

Saving Throw DC 33 Fortitude Saving Throw;

Maximum Duration 4 rounds

Stage 1 2d6 Poison Damage and Drained 1 (1 round)

Stage 2 4d6 Poison Damage and Drained 2 (1 round)

Stage 3 8d6 Poison Damage and Drained 3 (1 round)
